title: Purple Hammer Warrior
description: A confident young woman with long dark hair in a topknot stands in a dynamic pose, holding a massive purple warhammer with both hands. She wears an orange cropped top, dark purple pants with orange patterns, purple boots, and has tribal-style tattoos on her arms and face.
